subject: dsa
title: Detect Squares
summary: Keep a map of point to count. For a query corner, try each point as the diagonal partner needing equal x and y distance, then check that the two remaining corners are present.
problem: Support add(point) and count(query): the number of axis-aligned squares with positive area that have query as a corner, using the added points.

steps.caption: Count axis-aligned squares having the query point as a corner. Keep a map of point to count for fast lookups.
add (3,10), (11,2), (3,2). Each point's count becomes 1 in the map.
Query (11,10). Pick the diagonal corner (3,2): the x and y distances both equal 8, so it forms a square.
Check the other two corners (3,10) and (11,2). Both are in the map, so all four corners are present. That is one square.
All four corners exist, giving one valid square. Answer: 1.
